item.text: I’ll use each item’s actual expiration timestamp as the next eviction deadline. That lets short TTL entries be cleaned on the first cache operation after they expire, while avoiding full-cache scans before any entry can be expired. I’ll also have enumeration read only live items and keep loader errors intact.
